meaning: Homes that could be added on the extra floors the plan allows, limited by floor area and by free facade. A first filter, not a design and not a permit.
not_checked: structure of the existing building and its capacity for extra floors
whether the existing stair can be extended, and lift requirements
fire safety (DB-SI), accessibility of common areas (DB-SUA 9), energy (DB-HE), acoustics
owners' consent (propiedad horizontal), permits, party-wall and neighbour-light conditions
urban parameters other than the plan's height (occupation, setbacks, courtyards)
only Decreto 80/2023 arts. 9-10 and 51-56 are applied to the dwelling
ático: every free facade is set back 4 m (the street side is not known), the 3.20 m height limit and a pitched roof are not modelled, and whether the existing roof can host it

consent.what: Build new floors on the building
consent.needed: 3/5 of all owners who also hold 3/5 of the share quotas
consent.quote: estarán sujetas al voto favorable de las tres quintas partes del total de los propietarios que, a su vez, representen las tres quintas partes de las cuotas de participación, [...] la construcción de nuevas plantas y cualquier otra alteración de la estructura o fábrica del edificio

consent.what: Owners whose flat or local is affected by the works
consent.needed: their express consent, and a compensation agreed by the same majority
consent.clause: LPH art. 10.3.b and art. 17.4, last paragraph
consent.quote: En estos supuestos deberá constar el consentimiento de los titulares afectados y corresponderá a la Junta de Propietarios [...] la determinación de la indemnización por daños y perjuicios que corresponda.

consent.needed: the authorisation the planning law requires, after the owners' vote
consent.quote: Estarán sujetas al régimen de autorización administrativa que corresponda: [...] la construcción de nuevas plantas y cualquier otra alteración de la estructura o fábrica del edificio

consent.needed: a majority of owners who also hold a majority of the share quotas
consent.quote: el establecimiento de los servicios de ascensor, incluso cuando impliquen la modificación del título constitutivo, o de los estatutos, requerirá el voto favorable de la mayoría de los propietarios, que, a su vez, representen la mayoría de las cuotas de participación

consent.what: Possible unanimity (NOT decided: ask a lawyer)
consent.needed: all owners, if adding floors counts as a change to the title or statutes
consent.clause: LPH art. 17.6 and art. 5, last paragraph
consent.quote: Los acuerdos no regulados expresamente en este artículo, que impliquen la aprobación o modificación de las reglas contenidas en el título constitutivo de la propiedad horizontal o en los estatutos de la comunidad, requerirán para su validez la unanimidad del total de los propietarios

sale price.source: Range around Idealista's Valencia city resale average (3,378 EUR/m2, May 2026). The new-build premium and the Ruzafa premium are not verified.

VAT on new housing.source: 10% on new housing in Spain (research report, Construction business model economics).

hard cost.source: Optimistic = contractor price 1,131 EUR/m2 for the Valencian Community, 2026 (UPV/IVE report, advocacy author). The rooftop premium for access, crane and tie-in is assumed: no Spanish rooftop cost per m2 was found.

soft costs.source: Base derived from the Valencia protected-housing cost stack (Feb 2025): fees, licences, taxes and financing are about 32% of construction cost. Range assumed.

required profit.source: Listed Spanish developers show 22-27% gross and 6-8% net margins (2025), cyclical highs. A small project carries more risk per euro, so a profit share is assumed.

structural reinforcement.source: No source found for Spanish reinforcement costs or the load margin of 1960s-80s buildings. Needs an engineer's survey per building.
